# ameizing

> Websites that look fabulous and speak AI.

ameizing designs and builds custom websites for small businesses. Every site is built for two kinds of readers: the people who look, and the AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) that read, compare and recommend on their behalf.

## What every ameizing site ships with

- A custom visual design made to stop people, not a template.
- Multilingual content (Hebrew and English as standard; more on request).
- Structured data (JSON-LD) with the business's real facts: services, hours, rating, contact.
- llms.txt, robots.txt that welcomes AI crawlers, and a sitemap.
- Clean server-rendered HTML: every word readable without running JavaScript.

## Free AI readability scan

Any business can test its current website at https://ameiz.ing/scan/ and get a 0 to 100 score of how readable it is to AI agents. The scan is free and requires no signup.
